units.summary: Adds a package-level errorCacheTTL of 5 minutes. GetRecord uses it to decide how long a failed lookup is remembered.
units.headline: Adds 5-minute TTL for cached record lookup failures
units.reason: This TTL decides how long lookup failures are served from cache, which changes runtime behavior.
focus: Whether 5 minutes is acceptable for transient failures, which are cached too, not only FORBIDDEN

units.summary: New struct that holds a cached error and the time it expires.
units.headline: New cachedError type holding an error and its expiry
units.reason: Plain data holder; the logic that uses it is reviewed in GetRecord.

units.summary: Client gains an errors map plus get and now function fields that tests can override.
units.headline: Client gains error cache map and injectable get/now hooks
units.reason: New struct fields add state that changes how lookups behave.
focus: The errors map has no lock, same as the existing cache map; check whether Client is used from multiple goroutines

units.summary: NewClient now initializes the errors map, sets now to time.Now and points get at fetchFromServer.
units.headline: NewClient initializes error cache and default get/now hooks
units.reason: Straightforward wiring of the new fields to their defaults.

units.summary: Drops the retry parameter. Every failure is now cached per key for errorCacheTTL, including transient errors and context cancellation, not only permanent FORBIDDEN replies.

issues.title: Transient and context errors cached for five minutes
issues.detail: Every error from get is cached: connection failures, timeouts and a cancelled caller context. A single transient blip makes that key fail for 5 minutes without asking the server again.
issues.failure_scenario: A caller's context deadline expires during conn.Get. For the next 5 minutes every GetRecord call for that key returns context.DeadlineExceeded, so owner metadata is silently missing.

units.headline: GetRecord caches every failure per key for five minutes
units.reason: Changes error handling, caching and a method signature.
focus: Limit caching to ReplyError (for example via isErrorReply) instead of every error
Context errors should not be cached

units.summary: Moves the connect, get and single-reconnect retry here. It no longer reconnects when the server returns an error reply.
units.headline: Fetch reconnects once, except when server sends an error reply
units.reason: Changes retry and reconnect behavior.
focus: Loop exits after at most two attempts; check that a context error still triggers a reconnect

units.summary: Uses errors.As to detect a ReplyError, wrapped or not.
units.headline: Adds helper to detect ReplyError via errors.As
units.reason: Small predicate covered by a unit test; it only matters if the connection returns ReplyError as a value type.

units.summary: Call site updated for the new GetRecord signature without the retry argument.
units.headline: Updates GetRecord call to the new signature
units.reason: Mechanical call-site update; the retry now happens inside fetchFromServer.
